chung.Syllabus Name: 3D Modeling & Shading _ Xây dựng mô hình và tạo chất liệu trong môi trường 3D
chung.Description:
This course covers the fundamentals of creating 3D character UVs, creating textures with Substance Painter, and working with lighting and rendering. Substance Painter is clearly a very powerful texture drawing software. It helps 3D Artists to draw textures in a simpler & more intuitive way based on the available intelligent material inventory

Mastering this software also helps 3D Artist understand the properties of each material, thereby easily combining with other 3D software.
